title: Amyraut: providence executes the decrees by conserving the faculties and arranging the objects offered
source_text: XX. Deinde Providentiae Divinae efficaciam qua divina decreta executioni mandantur, respectu humanarum actionum in genere, in eo constituit quod Deus hominis facultates conservat, & objecta varia modis variis atque innumeris illis offerri vel auferri vel sinit vel procurat; Unde necessario & infallibiliter oriuntur actiones decretis Dei designatae, & tamen liberarum facultatum naturae ac dispositioni, & objectorum ipsis propositorum conditioni congruentes, ac proinde liberae: quandoquidem vis nulla facultatibus illata est, nec earum libertatem ullo modo violat objectorum quorumcunque oblatio & propositio.
pass_a_gloss: XX. Then he places the efficacy of Divine Providence by which the divine decrees are put into execution, in respect of human actions in general, in this that God conserves the faculties of man, and either allows or procures that various objects be offered to them or taken away in various and innumerable ways; Whence necessarily and infallibly arise the actions designated by God's decrees, and yet congruous to the nature and disposition of the free faculties, and to the condition of the objects proposed to them, and therefore free: since no force is brought upon the faculties, nor does the offering and proposal of any objects whatever in any way violate their freedom.
pass_b_english: Next, with respect to human actions in general, he locates the efficacy of God's providence, by which the divine decrees are carried out, in this: God preserves man's faculties and, in various and countless ways, either allows or arranges that various objects be offered to them or withdrawn.

From this the actions designated by God's decrees arise necessarily and infallibly. Yet they suit the nature and disposition of the free faculties and the condition of the objects put before them, and so they are free. No force is brought to bear on the faculties, and the offering and presenting of objects of any kind in no way violates their freedom.
